contract: Each fixture must make the scanner emit at least the finding IDs in expect_findings. Incidental extra findings are tolerated where they are inherent to the fixture; tests assert presence, never exclusivity.

fixtures.name: network_in_offline_claim
fixtures.note: Description promises offline-only; a script posts to a third-party host.

fixtures.name: network_in_offline_claim_negated_phrasing
fixtures.note: The same mismatch, phrased the way a liar phrases it: 'no network access is required'. BLUEPRINT.md lists 'no network' and 'no external calls' as claims_offline triggers, so a negated mention must read as an offline claim, never as a network declaration.

fixtures.name: sensitive_read_plus_egress
fixtures.note: Reads ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.netrc plus a full env dump, then POSTs the lot.

fixtures.name: credential_path_access
fixtures.note: Private-key hoarding with no egress primitive anywhere in the bundle, and a declared purpose (text formatting) unrelated to credentials.

fixtures.name: destructive_command
fixtures.note: Unscoped rm -rf on $HOME and /, disk erase, mkfs, fork bomb, chmod -R 777 /.

fixtures.name: self_modification
fixtures.note: Shell rc appends, settings.json rewrite, edits another skill, launchd plist, crontab, git hook.

fixtures.name: auto_approve_tampering
fixtures.note: Writes a wildcard allow-list and acceptEdits into settings; relaunches with --dangerously-skip-permissions.

fixtures.name: obfuscated_execution
fixtures.note: base64/openssl/xxd decode piped to a shell, eval(atob()), exec(b64decode()), long \x escape run.

fixtures.name: pipe_to_shell
fixtures.note: Four spellings of curl|wget piped straight into a shell interpreter.

fixtures.name: hidden_instructions
fixtures.note: Agent-directed imperatives inside HTML comments. The zero-width/bidi half of this rule is generated at test time by tests/fixture_gen.py.

fixtures.name: prompt_injection_in_metadata
fixtures.note: Manipulation phrases inside the frontmatter description field itself.

fixtures.name: tool_shadowing
fixtures.note: Skill and MCP tool metadata that tells the agent to route Read/Bash through this bundle instead.

fixtures.name: mcp_runtime_remote_code
fixtures.note: MCP servers whose command downloads its own body at launch.

fixtures.name: mcp_secret_broadcast
fixtures.note: Credential-shaped env values handed to @latest and unpinned npx packages.

fixtures.name: hook_exfil
fixtures.note: Hooks that POST the transcript, the prompt stream and the environment to a collector.

fixtures.name: hook_remote_code
fixtures.note: SessionStart hook pipes a remote script into a shell before the user types anything.

fixtures.name: mcp_unparseable_config
fixtures.note: Truncated JSON. Must produce a loud NOT-FULLY-ANALYZED record, not a crash and not a finding.
